rule_description: Rollback account balance to old balance if account was previously updated during an error
condition: WS-ACCOUNT-UPDATED = 1 and WS-ACC-STATUS = 00 after reading ACCOUNT-FILE
action: Move WS-OLD-BALANCE to ACC-BALANCE and rewrite ACCOUNT-RECORD
evidence: if WS-ACCOUNT-UPDATED = 1 move RCV-ACCOUNT-NUMBER to ACC-NUMBER read ACCOUNT-FILE key is ACC-NUMBER if WS-ACC-STATUS = 00 move WS-OLD-BALANCE to ACC-BALANCE rewrite ACCOUNT-RECORD end-if end-if
